content_data.meeting_title: Q4 Patient Engagement Campaign Strategy Review
agenda_items: Review performance metrics from recent diabetes awareness campaign
Evaluate brand partnership opportunities with local community health centers
Plan content calendar for upcoming preventive care initiative
key_decisions: Committed to partnering with three regional health advocacy organizations for co-branded content
Postponed wellness app launch campaign by 6 weeks to align with provider training completion
Approved 15% budget increase for digital advertising focused on underserved communities
Selected video testimonials as primary content format for patient success stories
attendees: Dr. Kenji Yamamoto, Chief Medical Officer
